reason: S1700 recorded that every ceiling in S1659-S1699 is a point estimate with no interval, against a standing convention to quote spread. This arm's decisive quantity is a 0.29-point difference (rank-8 v1 vs real v1); a point estimate cannot say whether it is distinguishable from zero, which is precisely the question S1699 owes.
scope: Adds uncertainty only. ROW-LEVEL cluster bootstrap: each of the 192 evaluation rows is one cluster. The rowcache carries no per-row document identifiers, so this is NOT a source-document bootstrap. Rows are 513-token census-prefix-deduped chunks and are therefore PLAUSIBLY but not verifiably distinct documents; the interval is labelled row-level throughout and must not be reported as document-clustered.
changes: Serialize per-row loss sums and covered counts for every arm and for the live and constant baselines.
Add a paired 2000-draw row-level cluster bootstrap of each arm ceiling and of the two decision differences (real - rank8, real - const).
Add a reconstruction known-answer check: the scalar CE recomputed from the per-row sums must equal the directly accumulated scalar to 1e-9.
Add pred_d: the 95% interval on (real - const) must exclude zero if the path contributes at all, and the interval on (real - rank8) is reported so the 0.29-point figure carries a spread.
Use unrounded estimands for every decision (S1700).
ledger_effect: No change to the 55.04% headline or any certified number; adds spread to S1699's owed arm.
